description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeImmigrationRecordDao class, which handles database operations related to employee immigration records in the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods for saving, retrieving, deleting, and searching immigration records, utilizing query builders and pagination.

classes.name: EmployeeImmigrationRecordDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for managing employee immigration records, providing CRUD operations and searching capabilities.

methods.name: saveEmployeeImmigrationRecord
methods.description: Saves an EmployeeImmigrationRecord entity to the database, assigning a new recordId if necessary, with validation.

methods.name: getEmployeeImmigrationRecord
methods.description: Retrieves a specific EmployeeImmigrationRecord based on employee number and record ID.

methods.name: getExistingEmployeeImmigrationIdsForEmpNumber
methods.description: Fetches existing immigration record IDs for a given employee number from a list of IDs.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeImmigrationRecords
methods.description: Deletes multiple immigration records for an employee based on provided record IDs.

methods.name: getEmployeeImmigrationRecordList
methods.description: Returns a list of all immigration records for a specific employee.

methods.name: searchEmployeeImmigrationRecords
methods.description: Performs a search of immigration records based on filter parameters, with pagination.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeImmigrationRecordsPaginator
methods.description: Creates and configures a paginator object for immigration record search query.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeImmigrationRecordsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of immigration records matching the search filter criteria.
